{{Quote|This is Echo Station Three-Eight. Unidentified object is in our scope. It's just over the ridge. We should have visual contact in about&mdash; What the&mdash;? Oh, no!|Station 3-8 trooper, upon sighting an Imperial probe droid|<ref name="ESBnovel" />}}
A '''trooper''' served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldier]] stationed at [[Echo Station 3-8]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. When an unidentified object, which turned out to be an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]], was spotted on Hoth moving toward Station 3-8, this trooper contacted [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] and informed the headquarters that the outpost had sighted the object.<ref name="ESBnovel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novel]]</ref> Before the soldier could identify the intruder, the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] destroyed Station 3-8, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the trooper and cutting off the transmission.<ref name="SW39" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is Three-Eight, Echo Command! We have ''visual contact!'' It looks like&mdash; N-no&hellip;!|Station 3-8 trooper|<ref name="SW39" />}}
This unidentified Rebel trooper first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] through a single line of dialogue. The character also appeared, albeit with slightly different quotes, in [[Star Wars (1977) 39|''Star Wars'' (1977) 39]] and ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''. While the novel and storybook have the trooper contacting Echo Base, the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] adaptation has Echo Base contacting Station 3-8 first.
